title: Visitor Identificator
shortDescription: A personalized digital identity that connects each visitor to your experience. It links interactions, content, and moments across physical and digital touchpoints.
longDescription: A flexible digital pass that assigns each visitor a unique token, enabling seamless identification, personalization, and data continuity throughout the experience. Whether accessed via QR code, NFC wristband, RFID card, or tagged object, it connects people to content, games, media, and rewards while tracking interactions in real time. It is the connective layer beneath the full BRDGE ecosystem, the foundation for connected visitor journeys across spaces, modules, and moments. It transforms a collection of interactions into a coherent, personal experience.

highlights.title: One Identity, Any Carrier
highlights.description: Assign each visitor a unique token through whatever fits the venue: a scanned QR code, an NFC wristband, an RFID card, a sticker, or a pre-sent link. Registration can be a frictionless anonymous tap or a richer sign-up with name, language, and preferences.

highlights.title: Anonymous Crowds Become Known Visitors
highlights.description: Without an identity layer, people pass through unseen. This makes every interaction attributable and connectable, so a visit stops being a one-off moment and becomes a thread you can follow, personalise, and pick back up after the exit.

highlights.title: Continuity Across Zones and Days
highlights.description: The token carries each visitor's state, history, and rewards from one touchpoint to the next, across separate zones and even return visits, so progress is never lost and returning guests pick up exactly where they left off.

highlights.title: Twists That Change the Whole Feel
highlights.description: Layer in VIP and tiered access, collectible stamps and badges at every stop, shared team tokens, progressive unlocks that reveal zones in sequence, return-visit rewards, pre-event activation that shapes what people find on arrival, or a physical keepsake printed at the end. Token interactions can even feed a live public data wall.

highlights.title: One Token, Many Worlds
highlights.description: Recast the token as a secret-agent mission dossier, an explorer's field log that stamps every discovery, a brand-world passport travelling between zones, a museum time-traveller assigned an era, or a conference delegate profile that ties together the talks attended and people met, each ending in a personalised takeaway.

highlights.title: Proof You Can Put in a Report
highlights.description: Bolt on a data layer that turns the identity signals into evidence: token activations, which zones each visitor touched, dwell time, completion and drop-off rates, and opt-in follow-up. Export it, anonymised where needed, straight into a CRM, a reporting deck, or a stakeholder presentation.

highlights.title: The Backbone of Connected Modules
highlights.description: It is the thread that ties the catalogue together. Journey Manager routes the visitor it recognises at each stop, Journey Recap turns their tracked path into a personal post-visit story, and Connected Photographer or Shared Gallery attach the photos they made to their token.

states.trigger: Visitor approaches the activation point or receives an entry prompt (physical or digital)
states.experience: The system presents a clear invitation: what the token is, why it matters, and how to get started. The experience communicates value before asking for action.
states.feedback: Idle animation, ambient motion, signage prompt, or branded idle screen
states.configurable: Headline message, visual identity, language, entry mechanic (QR, tap, scan, URL)
states.data: Proximity triggers or view count if sensor-equipped

states.trigger: Visitor scans, taps, or enters the activation flow to claim their token
states.experience: A unique token is generated and linked to the visitor. Optional: they enter a name, select a preference, or receive a physical carrier (wristband, card, sticker).
states.feedback: Confirmation animation, welcome message, token ID displayed or encoded
states.configurable: Registration fields (name, language, preference), token carrier type, onboarding message
states.data: Token creation timestamp, entry point, optional profile inputs

states.trigger: Visitor uses their token at one or more touchpoints across the experience
states.experience: Each interaction is recognized and logged. The visitor receives personalized content, unlocks, or progress: the experience reacts to who they are and what they've done.
states.feedback: Personalized visuals, progress indicators, unlocked content, or reward signals
states.configurable: Touchpoint logic, content per profile, unlock conditions, interaction pacing
states.data: Touchpoints visited, interaction depth, time spent, choices made, modules triggered

states.trigger: Visitor completes the journey, reaches a threshold, or exits the experience
states.experience: A summary, reward, or personal recap is presented. The token's full journey is surfaced: what was collected, achieved, or unlocked. Post-visit options are offered.
states.feedback: Journey summary screen, reward reveal, QR to personal gallery, share prompt, or printed output
states.configurable: Outcome format, reward type, post-visit CTA, share mechanics
states.data: Completion status, final score or outcome, exportable visitor record, follow-up trigger
